motion.name: page-navigation
motion.purpose: CSS-only cross-document root opacity handoff on same-origin ordinary links; no geometry interpolation. Reduced motion opts out; unsupported browsers navigate normally. No script, navigation delay or shared-image morph.

motion.name: hero-interface
motion.purpose: Shared link, input and action-surface color feedback; links have no underline and retain visible keyboard focus.

motion.name: localized-rain
motion.purpose: Optional bounded hero rain; disabled under reduced motion or Effects Off and suspended offscreen/hidden.

motion.name: contact-success-arrival
motion.purpose: Popup opacity 0 to 1 and 14px upward arrival via @starting-style; immediate entry fallback in older browsers. Mobile dimmer fades in over 220ms. Reduced motion preserves opacity and removes travel.

motion.name: contact-success-check
motion.purpose: Finite SVG check draw from stroke-dashoffset 32 to 0; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: contact-success-exit
motion.purpose: Controlled closing presence fades popup and mobile overlay together before DOM removal; auto-close starts at 5000ms, normally removing at 5180ms. Reopen cancels stale exit.

motion.name: directional-feedback
motion.purpose: Arrow travel 5px on hover/focus, text link 3px on fine-pointer hover, button lift 2px; short press scale. Reduced motion removes travel.

motion.name: introduction
motion.purpose: Once-visible section/project introductions from .7 opacity and 8px below. Content stays visible before enhancement; completed targets unobserved; reduced motion removes the entrance.

motion.name: mobile-menu-arrival
motion.purpose: Finite disclosure-nav arrival; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: floating-network
motion.value: desktop 48 nodes / 30 drawn fps / DPR≤1.5; compact 20 / 15 / DPR1
motion.purpose: Sparse cyan 2D network behind open reading areas. Fine-pointer displacement≤18px; no artwork/content movement. Hidden tabs suspend; reduced motion draws static; shared Effects Off hides and destroys. Backing store≤4M pixels, no animation library.

narrative.overview:
Midnight Network presents James Gatoru’s work inside a rain-lit, layered city. Blue atmosphere, ice-white lettering and cyan interface edges create an immersive setting; generous live typography and direct links keep the work legible and reachable.

The visual rhythm moves between expressive artwork and calm reading surfaces. Condensed italic display type supplies energy, while ordinary Exo 2 supports project narratives and controls. Atmosphere is a progressive enhancement: the complete composition and content exist before optional movement.
keyCharacteristics: Original city imagery with navy, cobalt and cyan depth.
Large, live condensed italic headings with restrained angular details.
Open project rows and thin rules rather than repeated floating panels.
Optional, locally scoped motion and a complete static presentation.

rules.name: The Signal Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Deep navy carries filled actions, cyan carries interface edges and feedback, and coral remains a small signal.

rules.name: The Live Type Rule
rules.body: Keep identity, headings, labels and controls as real HTML; artwork never replaces readable content.

rules.name: The Art Carries Atmosphere Rule
rules.body: Let imagery carry the cinematic depth; keep long reading surfaces calm and opaque.

rules.name: The Accepted Success Rule
rules.body: Show the popup only after an accepted successful response; its copy does not certify inbox delivery. Keep the existing polite live status as the single announcement, visually hiding its success copy while the popup is open and restoring it inline afterward. Do not force focus or trap it. Provide a labeled close button (44px square) with cyan keyboard focus, and Escape dismissal, plus automatic dismissal beginning after 5,000ms at every viewport width. Retain popup and mobile overlay for a coordinated 180ms closing fade, then remove them; disable and accessibility-hide the closing popup. Reopen cancels stale exit and starts a fresh lifetime; unmount clears timers. Restore submit focus only when dismissal removes focus from inside the popup. Focusing a form input or textarea dismisses without moving focus or clearing the draft; starting another valid submission removes stale success.

rules.name: The Bounded Feedback Rule
rules.body: Remove link underlines; preserve readable hover/focus colors, directional arrow feedback and visible focus outlines. Keep section/project entrances finite and visible by default, unobserve completed targets and respect initial/live reduced motion. City artwork stays stationary. The separately controlled floating network follows its documented frame, particle and pixel bounds.

dos: Do preserve the navy action, cyan interface and minor coral signal hierarchy.
Do keep all meaningful text and actions in HTML, with actual links and inline SVG icons.
Do reserve width for extended display lettering and let content reflow on narrow or short screens.
Do pair expressive imagery with quiet reading surfaces and visible illustrative-image labels.
Do provide keyboard focus, touch-sized controls and a complete reduced-motion presentation.
donts: Don't introduce acid yellow into the selected Midnight Network identity.
Don't turn the city composition into a full-page screenshot containing baked-in text.
Don't make information depend on hover, parallax, a forced intro or looping text distortion.
Don't move city artwork or let decoration obscure text; retain particle limits and Off/reduced-motion controls.
Don't turn every paragraph or archive record into a floating, shadowed card.
